top_performing_topics: Market timing and technical support levels for retail investors
winning_hook_formulas: The 'Stop Doing X' Warning: Start with a negative imperative that challenges a common financial behavior (e.g., 'Stop buying X before you check Y').
The 'Hidden Loss' Reveal: Highlight a specific, relatable financial vehicle and frame it as a 'secret' or 'trap' that is actively shrinking their purchasing power.
script_directives: Keep total duration strictly under 22 seconds to maintain high completion rates.
Eliminate preamble; start the hook within the first 0.5 seconds and move to the 'why' by second 5.
Use high-contrast visual overlays (charts or bold text) to support every claim, ensuring the visual changes at least every 3 seconds to prevent drop-offs.
seo_directives: Use high-intent, search-driven keywords in the title (Nifty, Stocks, FD, Inflation) rather than vague clickbait.
Limit hashtags to 3-4 highly relevant tags (e.g., #FinanceTips #StockMarketIndia #Investing) to avoid algorithmic dilution.
